claims.quote: The type series was collected from 'tributary of Rio dos Marmelos, Rio Madeira basin, 110 kilometers east of Humaitá along rodovia Transamazônica, Amazonas State, Brazil' in the western Brazilian Amazon, and most official records pertain only to this locality although the species may be more widely-distributed within the Madeira system.
